name: Structure vehicle deals and finance with lenders inside the CRM
summary: Structures vehicle deals and finance with lenders inside the CRM: reads new deals, drafts one finance pack per chosen lender, queues each submission for approval, and chases lenders that have not decided. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

covered_by.enquiry-intake: intake (deals in the CRM intake stage)
covered_by.credit-application: skill (the agent checks the application is complete and marks credit_ready)
covered_by.structure-deal: skill (the agent writes the lender order and amount into a proposal)
covered_by.lender-selection: skill (the agent picks lenders from settings)
covered_by.lender-submission: draft (one Outlook pack per lender) and approval (the send, then the stage move)
covered_by.lender-decision: skill (a person or the agent records the decision on the deal, which stops chasing)
covered_by.follow-up-declines: follow-up (chases a lender with no decision; re-submission after a decline is a skill step)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (internal note on the deal and a row in the deal register)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New deals in the CRM intake stage.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: For each deal the agent has marked credit-ready, draft one lender pack per lender, queue each send for approval, note the deal and log it in the register.

crons.name: follow-up
crons.summary: Mark deals submitted once their send is approved, and queue a chase where a lender has not decided (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a deal read, an internal note on a deal, an Outlook draft, a register row. Sending a lender email and moving a deal to the lender-submitted stage are live operations and wait for a person.

pipedrive.covers: deal intake, internal note, stage move after a lender submission

microsoft-365.covers: lender pack drafts, chase drafts, sends through approval, deal register rows

gaps: AutoManager (DeskManager): its help pages were read, but the kit has no ops file for it. Credit pulls, the lender network and deal build are unmapped. A live account is needed.
Autosoft: the 30 pages read were marketing and blog posts with no deal or lender workflow. Not mapped.
Mercury: a commercial and asset finance broker, not a dealer system. Its pages were blog articles. Not mapped to automotive deal structuring.
Lender decisions do not return to the CRM by any mapped platform. A person or the agent records the decision on the deal, and the chase stops then.
Payment, rate and term maths is a judgment step for the agent, not a cron. No lender rate or payment API is mapped.
Credit pulls and consent are not built. credit_ready is set by a person or the agent only after the application is complete and consent is on file.
Compliance checks (Red Flag, OFAC, adverse action, risk-based pricing) run inside the dealer system per its docs, so nothing is built for them here.
Customer presentation, settlement and funding, delivery and handover have no evidence and no mapped platform.
Accounting (QuickBooks transactions) is not mapped in the kit for this job.
Both adapters are docs-only until a sandbox account (Pipedrive trial, Microsoft 365 developer tenant) proves them.
